Subject: Re: Today’s Call

Sugam,

I want to address your email directly, as the tone and assumptions made toward my team were both inappropriate and unprofessional.

First, Aanchal operates with a high level of professionalism and respect for every prospective partner we engage with. Dismissing her efforts based on a 10-minute wait window, without seeking clarification or context, reflects a lack of courtesy and patience that is not aligned with how we conduct business.

Second, your comment regarding our “seriousness” is misplaced. We are extremely intentional about who we work with. Our team supports and partners with a large portfolio of established, growth-focused med spas across the country, many of whom we could have confidently referred in your direction. That level of access and network is not something we extend lightly, and it is built on mutual respect and professionalism.

Lastly, how someone communicates in moments like this tells us everything we need to know about potential alignment. Based on your response, this is not a partnership we would choose to pursue.

We hold a very high standard for how our team is treated, and we expect the same level of professionalism we extend to others.

Wishing you the best in your continued growth.

Bethany Gifford

Subject: Re: Today’s Call

Sugam,

I want to address your email directly, as the tone and assumptions made toward my team were both inappropriate and unprofessional.

Before the call, Aanchal took the time to send a thoughtful and proactive message to ensure the conversation would be productive. She specifically asked:

“Would you be the right person to discuss partnership and affiliate opportunities, or would it make more sense to involve someone from your partnerships or business development team? If that is you, wonderful. We will keep our call as scheduled.”

This was not a lack of research. It was due diligence and respect for your time, ensuring we had the right stakeholders involved for a meaningful partnership discussion. That is how serious organizations operate.

Dismissing that effort, and then making assumptions about our level of seriousness based on a brief waiting room delay, is both premature and unprofessional. A simple follow-up or request for clarification would have been the appropriate response.

To be clear, we are highly selective about who we engage with. We work with a large network of established, growth-focused med spas across the country, many of whom we could have confidently referred to a partner like yourself. Those relationships are built on mutual respect, professionalism, and clear communication.

Your response did not reflect those qualities.

How someone communicates in moments like this tells us everything we need to know about alignment. Based on this interaction, this is not a partnership we would choose to pursue.

We hold a very high standard for how our team is treated, and we expect that same standard in return.

Wishing you the best in your continued growth.

Bethany Gifford
